An idea you can sink into.

I developed product specifications and illustrated details for an officially licensed Snorlax bean bag chair for ThinkGeek, extending a recognizable character into a physical product.

ProjectThinkGeek · Pokémon
My roleProduct design · Specifications · Illustration

The project

An officially licensed Pokémon Snorlax bean bag chair for ThinkGeek. A physical product that translates a familiar character into an everyday object.

My contribution

I created specification sheets and illustrations. The project also included hangtag, sewn-in label, and specification design.

From character to product

This work shows another side of my practice: working through the physical details and supporting materials that help bring a product to life.
